experiment: reserved slots filled by sub-agent answers (prefill at slot position)

arms.filled: every slot prefilled with the corresponding sub-agent's answer
arms.empty: no slot filled (block stays masked / placeholder)

notes: empty arm shows the masked state: model hallucinates ('1234') or says it cannot find it
only2 shows partial unfill: exactly one slot correct per trial; other slots get the same code (gap-filling)
gap-filling is eliminated by the protocol sentence 'answer Qk only, reply I don't know for the others' (vLLM arms: contamination 10 -> 0)

failed_paths.what: splice the sub-agent's K/V computed at slot positions via position_ids override
failed_paths.cause: explicit position_ids with HF KV cache breaks the splice

failed_paths.what: pad the sub-agent's prefix to equal the slot start, then generate
failed_paths.cause: padding before the instruction makes the model summarize the shared prefix
